related.title: Hywind Tampen 浮式風電

related.whyEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.transfer: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。

practiceEn: Compare hornsea-2 wind resources with tampen wind resources and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to Hywind Tampen floating wind, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

related.title: 道格灘離岸風電場
related.transfer: 可遷移「掃掠面積與比功率」與「中途無功補償站」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；道格灘離岸風電場的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Swept area and specific power" and "The mid-route reactive compensation station" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Dogger Bank offshore wind farm must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦遠離岸 120 公里的交流併網：中途無功補償、2019 年大停電的教訓與遠海運維；道格灘離岸風電場則以英國首座以高壓直流併網的離岸風場：直流損失、無人換流平台、單圈發電量與全程效率為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on AC connection 120 km from shore: mid-route reactive compensation, lessons of the 2019 blackout and far-offshore maintenance; Dogger Bank offshore wind farm centres on britain's first offshore wind farm connected by HVDC: DC losses, an unmanned converter platform, energy per revolution and end-to-end efficiency, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「年發電量與容量因數」與「年發電量與容量因數」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「尾流虧損與機組間距」的模型移到道格灘離岸風電場，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「無人換流平台的輕量化」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Annual energy and capacity factor".
Move the model of "Wake deficit and turbine spacing" to Dogger Bank offshore wind farm, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Lightweighting the unmanned converter platform", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「掃掠面積與比功率」與「中途無功補償站」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；道格灘離岸風電場的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Swept area and specific power" and "The mid-route reactive compensation station" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Dogger Bank offshore wind farm must be respecified.

related.title: 倫敦陣列離岸風電場
related.transfer: 可遷移「掃掠面積與比功率」與「中途無功補償站」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；倫敦陣列離岸風電場的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Swept area and specific power" and "The mid-route reactive compensation station" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of London Array Offshore Wind Farm must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦遠離岸 120 公里的交流併網：中途無功補償、2019 年大停電的教訓與遠海運維；倫敦陣列離岸風電場則以泰晤士河口的 630 MW 風場：環境限制、單月容量因數紀錄與沙洲上的沖刷為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on AC connection 120 km from shore: mid-route reactive compensation, lessons of the 2019 blackout and far-offshore maintenance; London Array Offshore Wind Farm centres on A 630 MW farm in the Thames Estuary: environmental limits, a record monthly capacity factor and scour on sandbanks, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「年發電量與容量因數」與「年發電量與容量因數」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「尾流虧損與機組間距」的模型移到倫敦陣列離岸風電場，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「單月容量因數的紀錄」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Annual energy and capacity factor".
Move the model of "Wake deficit and turbine spacing" to London Array Offshore Wind Farm, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "A record monthly capacity factor", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「掃掠面積與比功率」與「中途無功補償站」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；倫敦陣列離岸風電場的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
